units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 22. The Government of the Russian Federation may determine spheres of activity in which procurement is subject to a prescribed procedure for determining the initial (maximum) contract price, the price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and the initial unit price of goods, works or services, and may designate federal executive bodies, the State Atomic Energy Corporation “Rosatom” and the State Corporation for Space Activities “Roscosmos” as authorized to establish that procedure taking account of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 22 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 23. In information and documents subject to publication in the unified information system under this Federal Law, the initial (maximum) contract price, the price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), the initial unit price of goods, works or services, the initial total of those unit prices and the maximum contract price, where the quantity of goods or volume of works or services cannot be determined, shall be specified through the unified information system.
units.label: Part 23 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 24. Where the quantity of goods to be supplied or the volume of works or services cannot be determined, the contracting authority shall, taking account of requirements established under Article 19 of this Federal Law for the goods, works or services it procures, including their maximum price, and/or standard costs of supporting the functions of state bodies, governing bodies of state extrabudgetary funds and municipal bodies, determine the initial unit price of the goods, works or services, the initial total of those unit prices and the maximum contract price, and justify the unit price under this Article. Provisions of this Federal Law concerning use of the initial (maximum) contract price, including for calculation of application security or contract performance security, shall apply to the maximum contract price unless otherwise established by this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 24 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Initial (maximum) contract price, price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), and initial total of unit prices for goods, works and services
units.text: 25. For procurement of goods, works or services subject to a prohibition, restriction or preference provided for by point 1 of part 2 of Article 14 of this Federal Law, the Government of the Russian Federation shall establish special rules for determining the initial (maximum) contract price, the price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), the initial unit price of goods, including goods supplied in performing the works or providing the services being procured, and the initial unit price of works or services, based on the functional, technical, quality and operational characteristics of goods of Russian origin and works performed or services provided, respectively, by Russian persons.
units.label: Part 25 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 23. Procurement identification code and catalogue of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs
units.text: Article 23. Procurement identification code and catalogue of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs
units.label: Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Procurement identification code and catalogue of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs
units.text: 1. The procurement identification code shall be specified in the schedule, procurement notice, invitation to participate in a closed selection of a supplier (contractor, service provider), procurement documentation, contract and other documents provided for by this Federal Law. In information and documents subject to publication in the unified information system under this Federal Law, the code shall be specified through the unified information system.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Procurement identification code and catalogue of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs
units.text: 2. The procurement identification code shall link the documents specified in part 1 of this Article.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Procurement identification code and catalogue of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs
units.text: 3. The procedure for generating the procurement identification code, including its composition and structure according to its purpose of use, shall be established by the federal executive body regulating the contractual procurement system.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Procurement identification code and catalogue of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs
units.text: 4. Repealed from 1 July 2019. — Federal Law of 01.05.2019 No. 71-FZ.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Procurement identification code and catalogue of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs
units.text: 5. The federal executive body regulating the contractual procurement system shall ensure the creation and maintenance, in the unified information system, of the catalogue of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Procurement identification code and catalogue of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs
units.text: 6. The Government of the Russian Federation shall establish the procedure for creating and maintaining that catalogue in the unified information system, and the rules for using it.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.label: Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 1. Contracting authorities shall conduct procurement using competitive methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers) (hereinafter, competitive methods) or by purchasing from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider). Competitive methods may be open or closed. Under an open competitive method, the contracting authority shall communicate procurement information to an unlimited group of persons by publishing a procurement notice in the unified information system. Under a closed competitive method, procurement information shall be communicated by sending invitations to participate in the selection of a supplier (contractor, service provider) (hereinafter, invitations) to a limited group of persons capable of supplying the goods, performing the works or providing the services that constitute the procurement subject matter.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 2. Competitive methods are:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 1) tenders: open electronic tender (hereinafter, electronic tender), closed tender and closed electronic tender;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 2) auctions: open electronic auction (hereinafter, electronic auction), closed auction and closed electronic auction;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 3) electronic request for quotations (hereinafter, electronic request for quotations).
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 3. For the purposes of this Federal Law, an electronic tender, electronic auction, electronic request for quotations and procurement under part 12 of Article 93 of this Federal Law shall also be regarded as electronic procedures, while a closed electronic tender and closed electronic auction shall be regarded as closed electronic procedures.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 4. The winner of a tender shall be the procurement participant that offers the best terms of contract performance and whose application meets the requirements established in the procurement notice and procurement documentation, where such documentation is provided for by this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 5. The winner of an auction shall be the procurement participant whose application meets the requirements established in the procurement notice and procurement documentation, where such documentation is provided for by this Federal Law, and that, following the procedure for submitting contract price offers or offers for the total of unit prices of goods, works or services in the case provided for by part 24 of Article 22 of this Federal Law, offers the lowest contract price or lowest total of such unit prices, or, in the case provided for by point 9 of part 3 of Article 49 of this Federal Law, the highest amount payable by the participant for the right to conclude the contract.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 6. Except where procurement is conducted through an electronic request for quotations or from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), the contracting authority must use auctions to procure goods, works or services included in the list established by the Government of the Russian Federation, or in an additional list established by the highest executive body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation for procurement to meet that constituent entity’s needs.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 7. The contracting authority may use auctions to procure goods, works or services not included in the lists provided for by part 6 of this Article.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 8. Services for organizing children’s recreation and health improvement shall not be procured through auctions.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 9. The winner of a request for quotations shall be the procurement participant whose application meets the requirements established in the procurement notice and that offers the lowest contract price or the lowest total of unit prices of goods, works or services in the case provided for by part 24 of Article 22 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 10. A contracting authority may conduct an electronic request for quotations under this Federal Law:
units.label: Part 10 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 1) where the initial (maximum) contract price in the procurement does not exceed ten million rubles. The Government of the Russian Federation may decide to increase that price threshold for procurement of certain named medical devices;
units.label: Point 1 Part 10 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 2) regardless of the initial (maximum) contract price specified in point 1 of this part, for:
units.label: Point 2 Part 10 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: а) procurement resulting in a contract for the supply of goods necessary for citizens’ normal subsistence;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 2 Part 10 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: б) procurement of goods, works or services constituting the subject matter of a contract terminated by the contracting authority under part 9 or 15 of Article 95 of this Federal Law. Such procurement shall take account of part 18 of Article 95 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 2 Part 10 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: в) procurement by a contracting authority operating in a foreign state;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 2 Part 10 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: г) procurement of medicinal products required to be prescribed to a patient on medical grounds, namely individual intolerance or vital indications, by decision of a medical commission recorded in the patient’s medical documentation and in the register of decisions adopted at meetings of that commission. The quantity procured must not exceed the quantity needed by the patient over the course of treatment;
units.label: Subpoint «г» Point 2 Part 10 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: д) procurement of sports supplies, equipment and sports kit needed by Russia’s Olympic team and Paralympic team, and for preparing sports representative teams of the Russian Federation or its constituent entities for sports competitions and for their participation in them;
units.label: Subpoint «д» Point 2 Part 10 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: е) procurement of services to protect the interests of the Russian Federation where individuals and/or legal entities bring claims against it before courts of foreign states, international courts or arbitral tribunals, and Russian and/or foreign specialists, experts or advocates need to be engaged to provide those services;
units.label: Subpoint «е» Point 2 Part 10 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: ж) procurement of folk handicraft products of recognized artistic merit whose samples are registered in the manner established by the federal executive body authorized by the Government of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Subpoint «ж» Point 2 Part 10 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: з) procurement of residential premises for orphans, children without parental care, and persons from among those categories.
units.label: Subpoint «з» Point 2 Part 10 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 11. Closed competitive methods shall be used for:
units.label: Part 11 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 1) procurement of goods, works or services needed to meet federal needs, where information about those needs constitutes a state secret;
units.label: Point 1 Part 11 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 2) procurement of goods, works or services information about which constitutes a state secret, provided that such information is contained in the procurement documentation or draft contract;
units.label: Point 2 Part 11 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 3) procurement of insurance, transport and guarding services for:
units.label: Point 3 Part 11 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: а) valuables held by the State Fund of Precious Metals and Precious Stones of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 3 Part 11 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: б) museum objects and museum collections, rare and valuable editions, manuscripts and archival documents, including copies, of historical, artistic or other cultural significance, including where contracting authorities transfer and/or receive them for temporary possession and use or temporary use, including in connection with exhibitions in the Russian Federation and/or foreign states;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 3 Part 11 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 4) procurement of services supporting the activities of compulsory enforcement bodies of the Russian Federation for maintenance, operational monitoring and routine repair of buildings and structures, cleaning of those buildings and structures and adjacent areas, and carriage of freight, passengers and baggage;
units.label: Point 4 Part 11 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 5) procurement of goods, works and services conducted by:
units.label: Point 5 Part 11 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: а) contracting authorities that are federal executive bodies responsible for developing and implementing state policy in defence, state protection, state administration in ensuring the security of the Russian Federation, the activities of troops of the National Guard of the Russian Federation, internal affairs or management of the state material reserve, and their subordinate state institutions and state unitary enterprises; and also the State Corporation for Space Activities “Roscosmos” and its subordinate state institutions and state unitary enterprises. The Government of the Russian Federation shall approve the list of those contracting authorities, including the state institutions and state unitary enterprises subordinate to “Roscosmos”;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 5 Part 11 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: б) contracting authorities against which foreign states committing unfriendly actions against the Russian Federation, its citizens or Russian legal entities have imposed political or economic sanctions, and/or against which foreign states, associations and/or unions of states, and/or state (interstate) institutions of foreign states or of associations and/or unions of states have imposed restrictive measures. The Government of the Russian Federation shall approve the list of such contracting authorities. It may determine political or economic sanctions and/or restrictive measures whose imposition on or removal from a contracting authority constitutes grounds for including it in or removing it from that list;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 5 Part 11 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: в) contracting authorities using federal budget funds provided under contracts (agreements) on subsidies or budgetary investments concluded under budget legislation of the Russian Federation and containing a condition requiring closed competitive methods for procurement using those funds;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 5 Part 11 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: г) contracting authorities using funds provided from budgets within the budget system of the Russian Federation under contracts (agreements) on subsidies or budgetary investments concluded under budget legislation of the Russian Federation with the contracting authorities specified in subpoints “а” and “б” of this point;
units.label: Subpoint «г» Point 5 Part 11 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: д) state or municipal budget-funded institutions, state or municipal autonomous institutions, state or municipal unitary enterprises or other legal entities, on behalf of the contracting authorities specified in subpoints “а” and “б” of this point, within the powers transferred to them in the case provided for by part 6 of Article 15 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «д» Point 5 Part 11 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 6) procurement for the creation, modernization, supply, repair, servicing or disposal of weapons, military equipment and special equipment;
units.label: Point 6 Part 11 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 7) procurement of works for the exploration and use of outer space; creation, including development, manufacture and testing, of space materials and space technologies; creation, including development, manufacture and testing, modernization, supply, repair, servicing, use (operation) or disposal of space equipment; and development, production and supply of space infrastructure facilities.
units.label: Point 7 Part 11 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 12. Closed competitive methods may be used where contracting authorities are courts or where procurement supports judges’ activities.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 13. In the cases specified in points 3–7 of part 11 and in part 12 of this Article, closed electronic procedures shall be conducted under Articles 75 and 76 of this Federal Law. The Government of the Russian Federation may establish:
units.label: Part 13 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 1) cases where closed electronic procedures shall be conducted for procurement provided for by points 1 and 2 of part 11 of this Article;
units.label: Point 1 Part 13 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 2) special rules for closed electronic procedures and accreditation on specialized electronic platforms;
units.label: Point 2 Part 13 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 3) cases where a contract following closed electronic procedures shall be concluded without using the unified information system.
units.label: Point 3 Part 13 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers)
units.text: 14. A closed tender or closed auction may be divided into lots. For each lot, the invitation and procurement documentation shall separately specify the procurement subject matter, initial (maximum) contract price and its justification under Article 22 of this Federal Law, the amount of application security if the contracting authority requires it under Article 44 of this Federal Law, the deadlines and other terms for supplying goods, performing works or providing services, the amount of contract performance security if required under Article 96 of this Federal Law, and the amount of security for warranty obligations if required under Article 96 of this Federal Law. In such cases, a procurement participant shall submit one application for a particular lot. The contracting authority may cancel procurement for a particular lot under Article 36 of this Federal Law. Procurement shall be declared unsuccessful in respect of a particular lot in the cases provided for by this Federal Law. A separate contract shall be concluded for each lot.
units.label: Part 14 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24.1. Special rules for electronic procedures and closed electronic procedures
units.text: Article 24.1. Special rules for electronic procedures and closed electronic procedures
units.label: Art. 24.1

units.locator: Article 24.1. Special rules for electronic procedures and closed electronic procedures
units.text: 1. Electronic procedures and closed electronic procedures, including procurement participants’ requests for clarification of the procurement notice and/or procurement documentation, submission of applications and contract price offers, provision of access to applications to the procurement commission, comparison of participants’ price offers, preparation of records and conclusion of the contract with the winner, shall be supported on an electronic platform by its operator or, for closed electronic procedures, on a specialized electronic platform by its operator, unless otherwise provided by this Federal Law. The electronic platform operator or specialized electronic platform operator may not refuse to conduct the electronic procedure or closed electronic procedure on the respective platform.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 24.1

units.locator: Article 24.1. Special rules for electronic procedures and closed electronic procedures
units.text: 2. The Government of the Russian Federation shall establish:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 24.1

units.locator: Article 24.1. Special rules for electronic procedures and closed electronic procedures
units.text: 1) uniform requirements for electronic platform operators, specialized electronic platform operators, electronic platforms and specialized electronic platforms, and for the operation of those platforms. Those uniform requirements shall include:
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 24.1

units.locator: Article 24.1. Special rules for electronic procedures and closed electronic procedures
units.text: а) requirements for the charter capital of an electronic platform operator or specialized electronic platform operator, including its amount;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 1 Part 2 Art. 24.1

units.locator: Article 24.1. Special rules for electronic procedures and closed electronic procedures
units.text: б) requirements for electronic platform operators and specialized electronic platform operators to disclose information on legal entities and individuals directly or indirectly, through one or more legal entities, holding more than one percent of the voting shares (participatory interests) of the operator;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 1 Part 2 Art. 24.1
